newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan cotton rates steady amid selective trade.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan cotton rates steady amid selective trade.

text.p: Pakistan cotton prices were steady on Thursday amid selective buying by exporters and dealers said the market would open steady to weak on Friday.

"Apart from selective buying by exporters the market was quiet throughout the day," dealer Adil Nasim said adding prices were unlikely to strengthen given the overhang of more than 850,000 375-lb bales of unsold stocks held by ginners.
Kerb rates for NIAB-78 were around 2,000 rupees ($49.46) per maund (37.32 k.g.) and K-68 around 2,300 rupees, dealers said.
